title: Chapter 128 The Strength Of Qingmu Village
content:
Chapter 128 The Strength Of Qingmu Village

In Wana Village, Wang Shuo ordered his men to tie several bandits to a cross.

Before he could be tortured, the bandit leader confessed everything.

This bandit leader was called Ma Enza, one of the 40 leaders of Qingmu Village.

According to him, there were more than 400 bandits in Qingmu Village, and there were 4 leaders in total.

They had all been transferred to military commanders, and three of them were at level 30.

The leader, Zhang Wenlong, was at level 32, and his strength was unfathomable.

Wang Shuo's heart skipped a beat, and his face instantly darkened.

It seemed that this village still had some strength!

Wang Shuo was not sure if Ayub could deal with the 32-level military commander, and it was probably difficult.

If Gong Zheng was added, he should be able to deal with it.

However, the opponent still had 3 military commanders.

He should not be able to fight a military commander alone.

Moreover, the opponent still had 400 ordinary bandits, and there was no way for him to deal with the 20 or 30 people!

Headache!

If the city wall is not built, and the enemy comes out in full force, it is very likely that Wana Village will be wiped out.

It seems that we must hurry up and build the city wall.

After interrogating the bandits, Wang Shuo quickly devoted himself to the work of firing city wall bricks.

He found all the masons and gave priority to making earth kilns.

In the northwest of the territory, ten earth kilns were directly planned, and the people were asked to extract clay from local materials.

As for the final city brick production, it had to wait until Wang Shuo came to do it.

Back in the tent, Wang Shuo continued to comprehend the production technology of black iron city bricks.

In the evening, the sneaky man who secretly observed Wang Shuo's village finally returned to his own village.

It was Fengze Village.

Zhao Tianze did not suffer heavy damage when defending against wild beasts.

The beasts that besieged his territory only had one silver boss, three bronze bosses, and 300,000 ordinary beasts. For the powerful Fengze Village, it was simply a gift of experience.

And the food was delivered to the door for free.

So before the beasts attacked the village, he had already started to expand outward.

In Fengze Village, there were no other villages within 20 miles around.

After two days of conquest, Fengze Village had accumulated up to 800 refugees.

He used iron-blooded means to directly force everyone to join Fengze Village. After beheading several disobedient refugees in public, the others could only succumb to his tyranny.

Moreover, he had just recently obtained an archer barracks, which could train archers in large quantities.

When he thought of the spectacular scene of thousands of arrows shooting at the same time and arrow feathers flying all over the sky.

Zhao Tianze's heart was suddenly filled with pride.

"I am indeed the son of destiny." Zhao Tianze sat on the throne in a hall, complacent in his heart.

"Report."

The voice from outside the door interrupted Zhao Tianze's self-intoxication.

"Come in." Zhao Tianze was a little unhappy, and the smile on his face quickly disappeared.

"Report to the lord, the subordinates found the trace of Wana Village."

"Eh!?" Zhao Tianze opened his eyes suddenly, and instantly regained his calm.

"Finally found you." He showed a wicked smile at the corner of his mouth, snorted lightly, "When I was in the trial space, you blocked my way to wealth. Next, you will bear my anger!"

His face was gloomy as water, and his right hand suddenly clenched into a fist.

Afterwards, he seemed to think of something, and muttered lightly: "Let you jump around for a few more days. When the time comes, I must let you know what cruelty is."
